verification: Opened full PDF in web tool; read methodology pp.2-5, Ontario pp.94-100. Direct executor download blocked by outbound proxy; linked spreadsheet returned verification interstitial, so no spreadsheet data claim.
unit: Hypothetical annual government-transfer income of specified single-person household, not observed recipient average or province-wide total.
model_assumptions: No employment earnings, no other income/assets
Lives in Toronto in private-market rental housing with utilities included

numerator.federal_details: GST/HST regular credit 293, pandemic top-up 290, Climate Action Incentive 224 for both; ODSP example also GST/HST supplement 89.10. Provincial benefits are Ontario Trillium Benefit. Published components and total are rounded.

pandemic_treatment.included: Federal GST/HST one-time top-up of 290 per single household; already part of total, not additional to it. Climate Action Incentive 224 is included but not classified as a pandemic payment.
excluded: CERB: model households lost employment before pandemic
CRB: model households had no employment income
EI: excluded consistently with report model
Federal disability one-time 600: households do not receive qualifying federal programs
Ontario Emergency Benefit: application required and fewer than 50% of recipients received it; report includes automatic benefits or discretionary benefits received by over half of eligible recipients

denominator.measure: Market Basket Measure, Toronto, single person
denominator.status: Estimated by Maytree using 2019 Toronto MBM threshold and city CPI; official 2020 MBM not available at publication
denominator.disability_costs: Does not include additional disability costs

source_inconsistencies: Ontario component table on printed p.94 states ODSP total 15665, but same-page narrative, cross-Canada table, time-series narrative and adequacy chart all give 15655. Components 14028+896+731 sum to 15655; retain 15655 and flag table typo.

Printed OW gap to MBM is 14414, whereas subtracting rounded chart amounts 24722-10309 gives 14413. Use published rounded levels for prototype calculations and disclose rounding; do not claim dollar-level precision.
comparison_limits: Not a measure of all social protection or actual household outcomes
Not directly representative of every recipient or all Ontario locations
2020 denominator is publication-vintage estimate; keep distinct from later revised observed MBM values
Use consistent MBM base before connecting across years; do not merge 2018-base with 2023-base silently
ODSP adequacy comparison omits extra disability costs; higher ratio is not proof of better program performance
